title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
abstract: arXiv:2610.24453v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson

translated_title: Hippo：基于海马体重放机制的无训练智能体自我进化
translated_abstract: 受递归自我改进（RSI）的启发，我们研究了LLM智能体如何在不更新模型参数的情况下通过外部记忆进行学习。从单次尝试中提取有用经验是困难的：有缺陷的推理可能带来成功，而糟糕的执行可能掩盖良好的策略。随时间推移保持经验的价值同样困难：我们未经过巩固的累积基线最初有所提升，但最终表现低于无记忆基线。我们的核心思想是比较同一任务的多次尝试，以识别可复用的决策并细化其适用条件。我们提出了Hippo，一个受选择性海马体编码与重放机制启发的记忆框架，在诊断出缺陷时从这些比较中学习。它将所得经验与现有记忆进行比较，以合并重叠部分并通过明确的适用条件解决冲突。这使得先前的指导能够被修订，而无需存储每一条经验教训。
tldr: Hippo受海马体选择性编码与重放机制启发，通过比较同一任务的多次尝试来识别可复用经验，并在合并重叠与解决冲突的过程中不断修正已有指导，实现了无需更新模型参数的LLM智能体自我进化。
en_tdlr: Hippo, inspired by hippocampal selective encoding and replay, enables training-free LLM agent self-evolution by comparing attempts on the same task to extract reusable experience, merging overlaps and resolving conflicts to refine prior guidance without storing every lesson.
